en: The Triplet of the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet of the Defiled (Saṅkiliṭṭhattika)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, defiled, and subject to defilement, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable, not non-reactive, and not defiled or subject to defilement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are six under root, six under predominance … pe … six under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not-afflicted-but-purifying, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable-nor-reactive nor not-afflicted-but-purifying, by way of root condition.
